_about: DRAFT research data — NOT wired into the app. Old dialect / colloquial Singapore place names used by elderly Chinese Singaporeans, for owner review before adding to the alias table. Coordinates come from the app's /api/search?step=1 (OneMap) on 2026-11-20 unless noted. confidence: high = referent confirmed by an authoritative source and target is obvious; medium = referent sourced but target/extent judged, or only secondary sources; low = unconfirmed ("?") — ask an elder.
